label: Lenovo ThinkCentre M90q Gen 4
description: 1-litre tiny desktop, 13th-gen Core, external adapter and one 1GbE RJ45 on the rear.
notes: 1GbE RJ45 standard (Intel I219-LM); Wi-Fi 6E is an optional M.2 card, so the stock unit is wired-only. Tiny footprint makes it the usual 'one PC per desk' node in dense topologies.
